newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American completes Myrtle Beach buy.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American completes Myrtle Beach buy.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said it completed its acquisition of the 385-room Myrtle Beach Hilton Oceanfront Golf Resort in Myrtle Beach, S.C., for $35 million, representing the company's first entrance into this year-round resort market.
Patriot will invest approximately $2 million on a total renovation of the guest rooms and refurbishment of the property's exterior, and is evaluating a potential re-flagging of the property.

According to Paul A. Nussbaum, Patriot's chairman and chief executive officer, the company's acquisition of the Myrtle Beach Hilton represents a significant opportunity for Patriot to capitalize on the revenues generated by that community's year-round visitors.

"Myrtle Beach is becoming a year-round vacation mecca as a result of new investment in local retail and entertainment venues, as well as its position in the heart of the 60-mile long Grand Strand, which features more than 90 championship golf courses," Mr. Nussbaum said. "AAA currently ranks Myrtle Beach as the second most frequently visited summer destination in the U.S. and, according to a March 1996 study, the average length of stay along the Grand Strand is the highest among all major vacation destinations: 5.7 days. We expect this property to be a consistently top-performing property in our portfolio," he said.
